purpose: Wake owners for actionable CortexKit CI failures at most twice per run, naming failing tests from bounded job-log tails when available, skipping superseded attempts and ignored workflows/jobs; merge-queue repeats of jobs already red on the default branch update silently. Quiet (digest only, no wake): cortexkit/cerebellum, CI off by owner decision; unreadable supersession checks fail open.
explanation: Routes CortexKit workflow failures to each repository's owner. Wakes for failed jobs on default, protected and fleet-owned branches, at most twice per run; a startup failure can wake without a job. Magic Context wakes only on master, train/* and bench/*. Contributor branches, runs with no failed job yet, jobs that never started, green recoveries and repeated merge-queue failures stay silent; Cerebellum is digest-only while its CI is off. Ignores routine design gates and the shared Review findings check, whose own flow reports review threads. Names workflows and failing tests when available, skips superseded attempts and stale completions, and groups silent-only runs by repository and branch.
changes: v19 names the workflow in titles and bodies, ignores Review findings and review-findings across all repositories, and replaces per-run silent notices with one branch digest showing a count and the newest few runs. This avoids repeated, misleading CI notices for contributor branches while preserving wake alerts and their updates. No extra merged-PR lookup is added.
